use_cases: Interactive product cards that reveal additional details on hover
Gallery or portfolio cards with overlay information that slides in smoothly
E-commerce quick-view cards with pricing and actions revealed on mouse enter
Dashboard widgets that expand footer content on interaction
Team member or testimonial cards with hidden bio information
ai_summary: A React card component with an animated curtain/wipe reveal effect that exposes footer content through a smooth clipPath animation on hover. Built with motion/react for physics-based transitions and React context for state management, it provides an elegant hover-triggered interaction pattern. The component uses Tailwind for layout and styling, featuring a responsive flex column structure with overflow handling, making it ideal for product showcases, galleries, and interactive card interfaces.
